next_check: Install river in a new prefix, run `evaluate.progressive_val_score` with a label delay on a retained free data stream, and emit a validation report artifact.

preregistration.expectation: river 0.26.1 in a new uv venv runs evaluate.progressive_val_score over a retained free stream (the hash-pinned bundled LEAN SPY/QQQ/IWM daily files already used by research-evaluation/plan.json) with labels revealed only after the label horizon (delay), and a second run with no delay; a JSON validation report is emitted with checkpoints and final metrics. Expected: both runs exit 0; delayed and immediate metrics differ, showing the delay changes what the model has learned at prediction time.
criteria: Input hashes verified against research-evaluation/plan.json before parsing.

Stream: one sample per session from 2014-2021Q1; features are trailing close returns known at close t; target is the sign of the open(t+1)->open(t+6) raw-price return (the plan's label); moment = session date; delay = the date of t+6 minus date t (label known at exit). A probe verifies river actually delays: a model whose learn_one records the moment it is called must never learn a label before its delay has elapsed.
Report: validation-report.json with checkpoints, final metric, sample counts and the delayed-vs-immediate comparison.
No trading-performance claim: this is a progressive-validation mechanics check.
